title: Owner: enter the parts and print one
goal: The owner's printed parts are in the fleet and one part prints from chat
acceptance: Owner adds the AOS 5 and Pavo20 Pro parts (file paths, TPU profile) via import or chat
Owner asks to print one part and confirms the Bambu Connect hand-off opens with the right file, count and profile
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; the owner's part list and file paths stay in private fleet data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
